items.title: US death row inmate Christa Pike awake and speaking after failed execution, lawyers say
items.description: Experts and lawyers called the apparent recovery unprecedented, noting she is believed to be the only known person to survive a lethal injection.

items.title: Tear gas in Paris and Marseille as school protests grow across France
items.description: Crowds of mainly teenagers called for more resources for schools and an end to what they called police repression.

items.title: Former German spy chief arrested for espionage and treason
items.description: August Hanning is accused of obtaining classified information for a foreign power.

items.title: A beautiful Himalayan bird is changing its voice due to human activity, research shows
items.description: A sharp increase in human activity is affecting the way the Himalayan monal lives and communicates, studies show.

items.title: Lawyer for one of Cornell 7 calls for special prosecutor to be removed over previous comments
items.description: New York Attorney General Letitia James is investigating the rape allegations, but the lawyer says comments she made on the case should disqualify her.

items.title: Finland orders halt to work on two Google data centres
items.description: The order affecting two planned data centres follows concerns over forest clearance.

items.title: Kenya confirms its first Ebola death as outbreak spreads
items.description: The patient had been living in DR Congo, where more than 4,000 people have died from the disease this year.

items.title: AfD candidate elected speaker of German regional parliament for first time
items.description: Although Tobias Rausch's role is largely symbolic, opponents have described the result as a watershed moment.

items.title: 'Ghost particles' from space telescope wins physics Nobel
items.description: Belgian physicist Prof Francis Halzen has won for his pioneering work on an observatory that detects particles from space.

items.title: Ship sinks and crew missing after Black Sea drone attack
items.description: It is not clear who is behind the attacks which come as Russia intensifies strikes in the Black Sea as part of its war against Ukraine.

items.title: Indian opposition MPs detained in protest against election chief
items.description: Opposition leaders have alleged that CEC Gyanesh Kumar manipulated voter rolls to favour Prime Minister Narendra Modi's party during elections.

items.title: White House defends Trump comment to let Iran 'take out' LA and San Diego
items.description: Gavin Newsom called the remarks "deranged", but the White House said Trump was warning of the risk of a nuclear Iran.
